title: SkyBlockToolkit
description: A lightweight modpack built for Hypixel SkyBlock, focused on quality-of-life improvements, performance, useful utilities, and a smoother overall gameplay experience.
body:
# SkyBlockToolkit

A lightweight and optimized modpack designed specifically for **Hypixel SkyBlock** players.

This pack combines performance improvements, quality-of-life enhancements, and useful SkyBlock utilities to help you focus on grinding, farming, mining, combat, dungeons, and everything in between without unnecessary clutter.

Whether you're a new player starting your SkyBlock journey or a veteran managing multiple profiles, **Hypixel SkyBlocker** aims to provide a smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable experience.

![SKyblock](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/N8Fpl6AW/images/aec7a51bfa3f3fcc0f94d4e688fc0ae21f3713ee.png)

## Features

✅ Optimized for better performance

✅ Useful SkyBlock-focused enhancements

✅ Quality-of-life improvements

✅ Lightweight and easy to run

✅ Vanilla-friendly experience

✅ Regular updates and maintenance

## Who Is This For?

* New Hypixel SkyBlock players
* Experienced grinders
* Farmers and miners
* Dungeon runners
* Players looking for better FPS and smoother gameplay

## Important

This modpack is designed for **Hypixel SkyBlock** and may contain features that are less useful outside of SkyBlock gameplay.

Always make sure to follow the latest Hypixel rules and guidelines when using any client-side modifications.

---

Enjoy a cleaner, faster, and more convenient Hypixel SkyBlock experience.

## Disclaimer

This project is an unofficial community-made modpack and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Hypixel or Hypixel Studios.
